_comment: Layout versions (stage 8, plans/layout-iteracion-1.md). The only place that decides which layout the skill uses. v0 is the frozen TFM layout; every candidate is the TFM harness with some render modules swapped (tools/layout-lab/harness/). Harness paths are relative to the engine root. Change the default only with the user's approval.
defaultDecision: User, 2026-09-26: v7 accepted as a correct change. It passes the objective gate against v6 and won the A/B vote 16-6 (the user believes the 6 v6 picks were key mistakes; votes kept as cast). Previous defaults: v6 (2026-09-26), v4 (2026-09-25).

v0.description: TFM layout (frozen engine f558eb0, apps/tfm-lab headless harness). Parity and corpus checks always use it.

v1.description: v0 + own bpmn-auto-layout pass per pool (idea A): replaces the layout-missing stride for pools 2+, stride kept as fallback for unreachable nodes; all later phases are v0

v2.description: v1 + vertical pool order minimising pools crossed by message flows (idea B); ties keep the DSL order

v3.description: v2 + per-pool horizontal shift aligning message flow ends (idea C); frames keep a common left edge. Lost the vote in both views.

v4.description: v2 + title bands kept clear (idea E1): all pool/lane frames widened left by the deepest intrusion of any shape or (estimated) label into a title band; nothing else moves

v5.description: v4 + label-aware artifact placement: data object/store names and other elements' external labels count as footprint/obstacles, annotations sized to their text, associations may not leave through their artifact's name; v0 rules as fallback

v6.description: v5 with artifact rules tuned from the user's notes: straight associations for near artifacts (bend on a route < 250 px costs 250), soft air (shape within 12 px costs 100), same-name artifacts in a pool pulled together when within 350 px

v7.description: v6 + common pool width (every pool and its lanes reach the widest pool's right edge) and lanes filling their pool (no empty strip above the first lane or below the last); frames only grow, nothing else moves

v8.description: v7 + proposal C: v6 artifact rules without cohesion and with a reach limit (each px of an association beyond 250 px costs 1 more), so air no longer pushes artifacts away from their node

v9.description: v7 + proposal G: an event name goes above the event when the default box below collides with shapes, flows, associations or labels and above collides less (and stays in its lane)

v10.description: v7 + proposal D: tasks as wide as their longest word needs (12 px Arial, 7 px padding), widened right after the per-pool auto-layout; the rest of the process shifts right

v11.description: v7 + proposal B: while an artifact has no clean spot, open a band under the row of its first linked node (everything below moves down) and place again; at most 6 rounds

v12.description: v7 + proposal A: bpmn-auto-layout 0.5.0 with Grid.addAfter fixed (vendored in the harness): a node takes the next free cell instead of being spliced into its row, which pushed row tails such as gateways to the far right; an occupied cell opens a column in every row
